## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: Running migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh on a legacy fixture rewrites .claude/dso-config.conf with dso.workflow=<local|ci-pr> and legacy keys commented-out with annotation
- DD2: Running migrator twice produces zero-byte diff on second run (idempotency via sentinel marker)
- DD3: --dry-run reads and reports without modifying any file
- DD4: Exits 0 without modification when run from plugin source tree; host project with plugins/dso/ subdir but no plugin.json is correctly treated as host project
- DD5: Atomic write via temp file + fsync + rename; sentinel .claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated created only after config-rename succeeds
- DD6: Grammar validation rejects inline comments after values, quoted values, duplicate keys, CRLF line endings with non-zero exit and clear stderr diagnostic, without mutating file
- DD7: If .dso-config.conf.pre-migrate-backup exists from prior failed run, detects it and does not overwrite it

## File to Create
- plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh (new executable script)

## Implementation Specification

### Script Header
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Idempotent migrator: rewrites .claude/dso-config.conf to use dso.workflow=<local|ci-pr>
# Usage: migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh [--target <host-project-root>] [--dry-run]
# Flags:
#   --target <path>  Host project root (default: git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
#   --dry-run        Report without modifying any file
# Exit codes:
#   0 — Success (including idempotent re-run and self-guard)
#   1 — Fatal error (grammar violation, missing config, backup collision, etc.)
set -euo pipefail

### Argument Parsing
Parse --target and --dry-run flags.

### Plugin-Source-Repo Self-Guard
Check for plugin.json at target root. If found: emit notice to stderr, exit 0.
IMPORTANT: host project with plugins/dso/ subdir but NO plugin.json must NOT trigger this guard.

### Marker Check (Idempotency)
Sentinel: TARGET/.claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated
If sentinel exists: exit 0 immediately.

### Config File Resolution
CONFIG=TARGET/.claude/dso-config.conf
If config not found: emit error to stderr, exit 1.

### Grammar Validation (before any write, reject without mutating)
Reject with exit 1 + stderr diagnostic when:
1. Any legacy key line contains inline comment after value (e.g., merge.strategy=pr # comment)
2. Any legacy key line contains quoted value (starts with single or double quote)
3. Duplicate legacy key (same key appears more than once as non-comment line)
4. CRLF line endings anywhere in the file

### Legacy to dso.workflow Mapping (3-line inline block - same logic as S1 shim)
_merge=$(grep -m1 '^merge\.strategy=' "$CONFIG" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2-)
_enforce=$(grep -m1 '^enforcement\.strategy=' "$CONFIG" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2-)
if [[ "$_merge" == "pr" && "$_enforce" == "ci" ]]; then _dso_workflow="ci-pr"; else _dso_workflow="local"; fi

### Backup Detection
BACKUP=CONFIG.pre-migrate-backup
If backup already exists: emit error to stderr (prior failed run detected), exit 1.

### Dry-Run Path
If --dry-run: print 'DRY-RUN: dso.workflow=VALUE' and exit 0.

### Atomic Write Sequence (production path)
1. cp CONFIG to BACKUP
2. Write new config to CONFIG.migrate-tmp.PID in same directory:
   a. Add dso.workflow=VALUE line (after version/comment header)
   b. Comment out each legacy key line: prefix with '# migrated to dso.workflow (vVERSION) - '
3. fsync the temp file (via python3 or sync call)
4. mv temp to CONFIG (atomic rename)
5. rm BACKUP (cleanup after successful rename)
6. touch TARGET/.claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated (sentinel)

### Output
Emit 'MIGRATED: dso.workflow=VALUE' on stdout after successful production run.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass: bash tests/run-all.sh
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | tail -3
- [ ] Lint: shellcheck passes
  Verify: shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh
- [ ] All 12 tests from task c7ca-d55e-d1e0-4774 pass (GREEN)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh 2>&1 | grep -E 'PASSED|FAILED'
- [ ] Script is executable (chmod +x applied)
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh
- [ ] Parity test passes (same dso.workflow from read-config.sh and migrator --dry-run)
  Verify: covered by test_migrator_parity_with_read_config_shim
- [ ] Grammar validation rejects all 4 malformed config types with exit != 0
  Verify: covered by test functions 8-11 in c7ca-d55e-d1e0-4774

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet-to-opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
